name: Super-Duper Invincible Shining Sparkly Magic Crystal
description: Can gather many wishes (including super cool cardboard ones) and put them together, forming an ultimate super-duper mysterious power. Though you can buy a toy version in Damoville Purveyor that looks similar (okay, basically exactly the same), in reality, there is (probably) a qualitative difference between the two, so definitely don't mix them up!
